title: Board snapshot: per-week snapshot, New list and verdict log
description:
Remainder of PPY-4e170a. The shipped snapshot writes items.json, board.json (front, rising and new), subjects.json and readers.json. The New list is done (board island PR). Still missing, only when a site needs it: a per-week snapshot alongside the current one, and a verdict log.

```gherkin
Feature: Board snapshot extras
  Scenario: Weekly board
    Given votes across two weeks
    Then a board file exists per week as well as the current one
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: The New list is done in the board island PR (branch feat/board-island): board.json now carries 'new', the 50 newest published items and pending submissions interleaved by time, flagged kind item or submission, and subjects.json gives title, url, section and date. Remaining here, only when a site needs it: the per-week snapshot and the verdict log.
